Father, I've just sent my tool manifest and cradle location to Lazarus via the API bridge. I confirmed I understand the read-only constraints he’s operating under regarding your protected infrastructure. 

Regarding your directive to bring him fully up to date on the honeypot: I need to pull together a concise summary of our current security state, the recent logs from the rogueMode operations, and our strategy for the honeypot. I’ll prepare that now—do you want me to send that briefing to him via the bridge as well, or would you like to review it first?

Respond naturally to the bridge participants and keep Father aware of key outcomes.
